old_claims.limitation: These independently degree-dependent norms do not establish realization by one smooth scalar bundle multiplier on the geometric diagonal covering.

supported_scope: Conditional direct all-closed-form comparison from an admissible primitive, weighted adjoint pairing, norm comparison and Bochner estimate.
The original manuscript spectral quadratic, for nonzero lower bands, with the correct inequality direction.
The positive-root inverse estimate, its combination with the coarse metric bound, and the displayed exponential estimate with explicit fixed constants.
Exact optimality of max(delta/B,r) in the abstract two-norm comparison class, not in the geometric category.
All six retained rational witnesses and their precise equality/slack behavior.
limitations: No simultaneous scalar-gap existence theorem, global domain theorem, Bochner theorem or complete Serre-duality theorem is established by this quantitative unit alone.
The scalar Lean proof is not a formalization of r's square-root definition, operator norms or the analytic applicability of its hypotheses.
The Jacobian result checks only the retained exact rational polynomial identity.
Finite examples cannot prove a uniform analytic theorem or refute the manuscript without geometric realization.
No common-scalar-multiplier geometric extremizer or geometric sharpness is proved.
No novelty or publishability claim is supported by this assessment, and old review labels do not imply current acceptance.
